#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compute count, mean, and median of the numbers in data.txt (one per line)."""

import statistics

with open("data.txt") as f:
    numbers = [float(line) for line in f if line.strip()]

with open("stats.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"count: {len(numbers)}\n")
    f.write(f"mean: {statistics.mean(numbers)}\n")
    f.write(f"median: {statistics.median(numbers)}\n")
